eyebrow.zh: 前沿中文 MoE · 一键探测启动 · 本地推理
eyebrow.en: Frontier Chinese MoE · probe-and-launch · local inference

headline.zh:
5 小时的换模型配置
压成一条自动选对的命令
headline.en:
5 hours of per-swap config
pressed into one command that picks right

sub.zh: 探测你的 GPU，为指定模型自动挑选 quant + backend + chat template，用合理默认值直接拉起。
sub.en: Probes your GPU, auto-picks the quant + backend + chat template for the named model, and just runs it with sane defaults.

body.zh: pynvml 探测 VRAM / 算力 / 架构族，nvidia-smi 解析兜底；没有 NVIDIA 卡也能用 --gpu 模拟一张 H100 看挑选逻辑。
body.en: pynvml probes VRAM / compute-cap / arch family with an nvidia-smi parse fallback; no NVIDIA card needed — --gpu simulates an H100 to demo the picker.

title.zh: 纯函数挑选器，算式可验

body.zh: (GPUProbe, ModelEntry) -> ranked Picks 是无 I/O 的纯函数；accuracy 为主轴，backend 吞吐与 VRAM 余量只破平局；--dry-run 打印每一项算式，不可行项也列出差距。
body.en: (GPUProbe, ModelEntry) -> ranked Picks is a pure, I/O-free function; accuracy is the primary axis, backend throughput and VRAM headroom only break ties; --dry-run prints the arithmetic, infeasible variants list the shortfall.

body.zh: 拼出后端 argv，把 vLLM 或 llama.cpp 作为子进程拉起，流式输出，打印 OpenAI 兼容端点 http://localhost:8000/v1——一个进程，没有微服务，没有 k8s。
body.en: Builds the backend argv, spawns vLLM or llama.cpp as a child subprocess, streams output, and prints the OpenAI-compatible endpoint http://localhost:8000/v1 — one process, no microservices, no k8s.

title.zh: YAML 注册表，数据非代码

body.zh: 护城河是版本化、硬件感知的 YAML 注册表——加一个 quant 下限或修一个 chat-template 引用只需改一行 YAML，无需碰 Python；fork 自己的注册表只需一个环境变量。
body.en: The moat is a versioned, hardware-aware YAML registry — adding a quant floor or fixing a chat-template reference is a one-line YAML change, no Python; fork your own registry with one env var.

headline.zh: 一条命令，跑起前沿中文 MoE
headline.en: One command to run a frontier Chinese MoE

sub.zh: uv tool install zerorun，然后 zerorun deepseek-v4——首跑会下载权重，是等待不是操作。
sub.en: uv tool install zerorun, then zerorun deepseek-v4 — first run downloads weights, a wait not effort.

tag.en: 5h → 1 command · probe your GPU, auto-pick quant+backend+template for frontier Chinese open MoE and just run it · MIT open source · Python · vLLM + llama.cpp
